blockers.detail: getaddrinfo() API enhanced with Service support, ares_parse_a/aaaa_record code refactored and shared with addrinfo parser. Private ares_addrinfo structure extended with ttls and cname chains. New functions ares__parse_into_addrinfo() and ares__readaddrinfo() added. Old harness doesn't call the new entry points or exercise the enhanced functionality, leaving ~527 lines of new/refactored code unreachable.

evidence: CISPA case study: 'cause: features, new feature adds code and exposes more code to harness, no harness update'

rationale.zh: c-ares库对getaddrinfo()进行了大幅增强：增加了Service支持、重构了ares_parse_a/aaaa_record与addrinfo parser共享代码、扩展了私有ares_addrinfo结构体增加ttl和cname链支持。新增了ares__parse_into_addrinfo()和ares__readaddrinfo()两个核心函数，重写了ares_getaddrinfo.c的大部分逻辑。但旧harness只调用基本的解析函数，不测试新的API增强功能，导致新增/重构的代码路径无法触达。属于本次引入的隐式API类退化。
rationale.en: The c-ares library significantly enhanced getaddrinfo(): added Service support, refactored ares_parse_a/aaaa_record to share code with the addrinfo parser, and extended the private ares_addrinfo structure with ttl and cname chain support. Added two new core functions ares__parse_into_addrinfo() and ares__readaddrinfo(), and rewrote most of ares_getaddrinfo.c logic. However, the old harness only calls basic parsing functions and doesn't test the new API enhancements, leaving the new/refactored code paths unreachable. Silent API degradation introduced by this change.
